definition: Tribadism; the standard clinical German term for vulva-to-vulva genital contact between two people, derived from Greek 'tribein' (to rub).

definition: Intercrural sex; the clinical German compound for non-penetrative sex in which the penis is thrust between a partner's closed thighs.
notes: A specific subset of frottage mapped to that concept as closest registry entry; historically practiced in ancient Greece as an accepted form of male-male contact; used in some cultures as a virginity-preserving substitute for penetrative intercourse.

definition: Paraphilia; the standard German clinical term for any persistent pattern of sexual arousal centered on atypical objects, situations, or individuals, as classified in DSM-5 and ICD-11.
notes: Direct German equivalent of the DSM-5/ICD-11 clinical term; used in German psychiatry, forensic medicine, and sexology; recognizable to educated lay speakers but not widely known in the general public.
